note: The http generator on a column longer than one request, and the columns that read its answers. Each implementation runs a small local service that behaves as `services` describes, puts its URL where a config says {{SRC}}, renders the config through the engine the config routes to, and checks two things: the output (or the error) exactly, and the requests the service received — sorted by offset, since parallel= may deliver them in any order. Every case here failed on 0.3.7 in all five implementations, or did not exist there: a column was ONE request (so its reply cap capped the whole run), a column that read an http answer saw an empty string, an http generator in a case, a branch or a field printed nothing, and parent= on an http column was ignored. A case may also list `seeds`: the X-TDC-Seed of every request, sorted — derived from the column the generator belongs to (Name, or Name.field), wherever in it the generator sits.

services.upper: A transform. Each input line L is answered with "H" + L. Echoes X-TDC-Offset.
services.row: A source. Line i of a batch is answered with "r" + (X-TDC-Offset + i). Echoes X-TDC-Offset.
services.row-no-echo: A source written before batches: line i is answered with "r" + i, and X-TDC-Offset is never sent back.
services.upper-no-echo: Like upper, but never sends X-TDC-Offset back.
services.fail-second: Answers the first request it receives like row; every later request gets a 500.

cases.name: a source cut into batches, placed by the row of the run
a transform sends each batch the inputs of its own rows
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="s"><sequence name="In"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c,d,e" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="Out"><gen type="http" src="{{SRC}}" in="In" batch="2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{In}}=${{Out}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a column inside one batch is one request
a source that ignores the offset is refused once there are two batches
cases.error: http service for sequence "Out" at {{SRC}} (rows 0–1) answered the batch at row 0 without echoing X-TDC-Offset — a service with no in= column must read the offset and send it back, or every batch would repeat the first

cases.name: the same service runs unchanged when the column is one batch
a transform needs no echo — each answer comes from its own input
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="In"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="Out"><gen type="http" src="{{SRC}}" in="In" batch="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Out}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: on_error="empty" blanks only the batch that failed
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="s"><sequence name="Out"><gen type="http" src="{{SRC}}" batch="2" on_error="empty"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>[${{Out}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a failed batch names its rows
cases.error: http service for sequence "Out" at {{SRC}} (rows 2–3) returned 500

cases.name: parallel= puts several batches on the wire and keeps their order
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="s"><sequence name="Out"><gen type="http" src="{{SRC}}" batch="2" parallel="3"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Out}}</data></line></block></tdc>
cases.output:
r0
r1
r2
r3
r4
r5
r6
r7
r8
r9

cases.name: an if= declared below reads the answer, not an empty string
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="In"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="H"><gen type="http" src="{{SRC}}" in="In"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen type="text" value="yes" if="H == 'Hb'"/><gen type="text" value="no"/></sequence><sequence name="E"><gen type="text" value="empty" if="H == ''"/><gen type="text" value="full"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{H}} ${{C}} ${{E}}</data></line></block></tdc>
cases.output:
Ha no full
Hb yes full
Hc no full

cases.name: a case that prints the answer prints it
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s"><sequence name="In"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c,d" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="H"><gen type="http" src="{{SRC}}" in="In"/></sequence><mix name="M" percent="100"><case><data>[${{H}}]</data></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{M}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a second http reads the first
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="In"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="H"><gen type="http" src="{{SRC}}" in="In"/></sequence><sequence name="HH"><gen type="http" src="{{SRC}}" in="H"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{H}} ${{HH}}</data></line></block></tdc>
cases.output:
Ha HHa
Hb HHb
Hc HHc

cases.name: row i reads answer i in a switch case, an if= branch and a field
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s"><sequence name="In"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c,d" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="Kind"><gen type="text" value="x,y,x,y" order="sequential"/></sequence><switch name="S" on="Kind"><case is="x"><gen type="http" src="{{SRC}}" in="In"/></case><default><gen type="text" value="-"/></default></switch><sequence name="C"><gen type="http" src="{{SRC}}" in="In" if="Kind == 'y'"/><gen type="text" value="-"/></sequence><sequence name="F"><gen name="a" type="http" src="{{SRC}}" in="In"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="z"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{S}} ${{C}} ${{F.a}}</data></line></block></tdc>
cases.output:
Ha - Ha
- Hb Hb
Hc - Hc
- Hd Hd

cases.name: a parent= child is blank where the parent does not hold
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="s"><sequence name="In"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c,d,e,f" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="Kind"><gen type="text" value="x,y"/></sequence><sequence name="P" parent="Kind.x"><gen type="http" src="{{SRC}}" in="In" batch="3"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Kind}} [${{P}}]</data></line></block></tdc>
cases.output:
x [Ha]
x [Hb]
y []
x [Hd]
y []
y []
